slides.title: Redesigning the Digital Front Door

content_blocks.block_data: Unit 1 · Foundations of Creativity and Innovation · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.1, 109.2

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: The Worst Website. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: Your customer's first contact with this business is already digital, whether the owner designed it or not.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.lead: The front door is rarely a website
block_data.body: For most businesses here it is a WhatsApp number, a Google Maps pin, or a photo someone else uploaded.
Search your anchor right now — whatever comes up is the front door, including nothing at all.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.lead: Redesign means the whole first contact, not a ho
block_data.body: mepage: what a customer sees, how they ask, how they pay, how they come back.
A correct Google listing with photos and real hours outperforms a website nobody visits.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: Brainstorm ideas to redesign a basic mobile app or website and create a creative solution — for your anchor's own digital front door.
Prescribed syllabus activity · Marathi or Hindi · 60 minutes

slides.speaker_notes: Leave this slide up for the whole making phase.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
